# CSIR-IICT Preclinical Collaborative Study Protocol
### Study Code: IICT-AETH-2026-VAL-01
**Title:** Real-World Chemical Synthesis, Biophysical Characterization, and Multidrug-Resistant Parasitology/Antimicrobial Profiling of In-Silico Designed Leads Generated by the AETHER-RAMI 14.2B Foundation Model.

---

## 1. Administrative Information
- **Principal Investigators:**
  - AI & Biophysical Modeling Lead: AETHER-RAMI Discovery Consortium
  - Wet-Lab & Medicinal Chemistry Lead: Chief Scientist & Head, Discovery Chemistry, CSIR-IICT
  - Parasitology & Pharmacology Lead: Senior Principal Scientist, Chemical Biology, CSIR-IICT
- **Collaborating Institution:** CSIR - Indian Institute of Chemical Technology, Uppal Road, Hyderabad 500007, India.
- **Estimated Study Duration:** 16 Weeks (Phases 1 to 4).

---

## 2. Four-Phase Experimental Roadmap

### Phase 1: Chemical Synthesis & Analytical Release (Weeks 1 – 6)
- **Objective:** Milligram-to-gram scale synthesis of priority lead series (`AETH-MAL-001`, `AETH-INHA-002`, `AETH-KRAS-001`, `AETH-COVID-001`).
- **Target Quantity:** 250 mg to 1.0 g per compound at $>98.0\%$ chromatographic purity.
- **Analytical Deliverables:**
  - $^1\text{H}$-NMR (500 MHz) and $^{13}\text{C}$-NMR (125 MHz) confirming structural connectivity.
  - High-Resolution Mass Spectrometry (HRMS-ESI, within 5 ppm mass accuracy).
  - Reverse-Phase HPLC-DAD purity profile (detection at 220 nm and 254 nm).
  - Powder X-Ray Diffraction (PXRD) / Melting Point determination.

### Phase 2: Primary Target Engagement & In Vitro Efficacy (Weeks 5 – 10)
- **Malaria (PfDHFR-TS):**
  - Recombinant enzymatic assay comparing wild-type PfDHFR vs double (S108N/C59R) and quadruple (N51I/C59R/S108N/I164L) resistant enzymes.
  - Whole-cell *in vitro* growth inhibition against *Plasmodium falciparum* chloroquine-sensitive (3D7) and pyrimethamine/artemisinin-resistant (Dd2, W2) strains using the 72-hour SYBR Green I fluorescence protocol.
- **Tuberculosis (InhA):**
  - Recombinant InhA enzyme inhibition and *Mycobacterium tuberculosis* H37Rv Microplate Alamar Blue Assay (MABA).
- **Oncology (KRAS G12C):**
  - Intact-protein mass spectrometry covalent adduct kinetics ($k_{inact}/K_I$).
  - NCI-H358 (G12C mutant) vs A549 (G12S negative control) 72-hour antiproliferative CellTiter-Glo assay.

### Phase 3: Tier-1 In Vitro ADME & Safety Profiling (Weeks 9 – 13)
- **Metabolic Stability:** Mouse and human liver microsomes (MLM/HLM) intrinsic clearance ($CL_{int}$) via LC-MS/MS parent depletion.
- **Cardiovascular Safety:** Automated patch-clamp assay measuring hERG channel current inhibition in HEK-293 cells.
- **Membrane Permeability:** Caco-2 bidirectional permeability ($P_{app} A \rightarrow B$ and efflux ratio $B-A / A-B$).
- **Ames Mutagenicity:** 5-strain Salmonella typhimurium fluctuation test (with and without S9 metabolic activation).

### Phase 4: In Vivo Rodent Efficacy & Pharmacokinetics (Weeks 12 – 16)
- **Rodent PK:** Single oral dose (10 mg/kg) and IV dose (2 mg/kg) in male Swiss albino mice; determination of $C_{max}$, $t_{1/2}$, AUC, and oral bioavailability ($F\%$).
- **In Vivo Malaria Efficacy:** *Plasmodium berghei* ANKA infection model (modified Peters' 4-day suppressive test).

---

## 3. Data Integrity, Blinding & Quality Standards
- To eliminate confirmation bias, compounds will be distributed in 24-well blinded plates labeled `IICT-VAL-001` through `IICT-VAL-024`.
- Experimental technicians will remain blinded to computational affinity rankings until raw dose-response data ($IC_{50}$) are deposited into the shared data schema.
- Data exchange will utilize automated ingestion scripts (`scripts/iict_data_ingestion_and_benchmarking.py`) to generate blinded parity plots against in-silico predictions.
